model_annotations.Bulgarian: Диаграмата представя разпределението на броя проби (samples) по шест категории на разсъждение (reasoning). Хоризонталната ос съдържа категориите, подредени в низходящ ред според стойностите им, като отляво надясно са изброени: Mathematical Reasoning, General Reasoning, Natural Scene Reasoning, Physical Reasoning, Logical Puzzle Reasoning и Chemical Reasoning. Вертикалната ос е етикетирана като „Number of Samples" и използва логаритмична скала, обхващаща диапазон от приблизително 10¹ до 10⁴, с основни деления при 10², 10³ и 10⁴. Всеки стълб е анотиран с конкретна числова стойност над него: Mathematical Reasoning показва 7025, General Reasoning — 1709, Natural Scene Reasoning — 413, Physical Reasoning — 232, Logical Puzzle Reasoning — 91 и Chemical Reasoning — 49. Стълбите са оцветени в еднакъв светлосин цвят без допълнително визуално подчертаване, засенчване или очертаване на отделни стълби. Височината на стълбите намалява последователно отляво надясно, като най-високият стълб съответства на Mathematical Reasoning, а най-ниският — на Chemical Reasoning.
model_annotations.Chinese: This chart displays the number of samples across six different reasoning categories. The horizontal axis contains the category labels, arranged from left to right in the following order: Mathematical Reasoning, General Reasoning, Natural Scene Reasoning, Physical Reasoning, Logical Puzzle Reasoning, and Chemical Reasoning. The vertical axis represents "Number of Samples" and uses a logarithmic scale, with major gridlines at 10², 10³, and 10⁴, spanning a range from approximately 49 to 7025. Each category is represented by a single vertical bar rendered in a uniform light blue color with dark outlines, and exact numerical values are annotated above each bar. The tallest bar corresponds to Mathematical Reasoning with 7025 samples, followed by General Reasoning with 1709, Natural Scene Reasoning with 413, Physical Reasoning with 232, Logical Puzzle Reasoning with 91, and Chemical Reasoning with 49, which is the shortest bar. The bars are arranged in descending order from left to right based on sample count. No bars appear to be visually emphasized through distinct shading, bolding, or additional annotations beyond the numerical labels displayed atop each bar.
model_annotations.English: This bar chart illustrates the number of samples across six different reasoning categories. The horizontal axis contains the category labels, ordered from left to right as: Mathematical Reasoning, General Reasoning, Natural Scene Reasoning, Physical Reasoning, Logical Puzzle Reasoning, and Chemical Reasoning. The vertical axis represents "Number of Samples" on a logarithmic scale, ranging from approximately 10¹ to 10⁴, with major gridlines at 10², 10³, and 10⁴. Each category is represented by a single vertical bar in a uniform light blue color with dark outlines. The bars are arranged in descending order of value from left to right. Mathematical Reasoning is the tallest bar with an annotated value of 7025, followed by General Reasoning at 1709, Natural Scene Reasoning at 413, Physical Reasoning at 232, Logical Puzzle Reasoning at 91, and Chemical Reasoning as the shortest bar at 49. Each bar is annotated with its exact numerical value displayed above the bar. The descending arrangement spans roughly two orders of magnitude on the logarithmic scale, from the tallest bar near 10⁴ to the shortest bar below 10².
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm stellt die Anzahl von Stichproben („Number of Samples") für verschiedene Kategorien von Reasoning-Aufgaben dar. Die horizontale Achse enthält sechs Kategorien, die von links nach rechts in absteigender Reihenfolge ihrer Werte angeordnet sind: „Mathematical Reasoning", „General Reasoning", „Natural Scene Reasoning", „Physical Reasoning", „Logical Puzzle Reasoning" und „Chemical Reasoning". Die vertikale Achse ist logarithmisch skaliert und trägt die Beschriftung „Number of Samples", wobei die Skala von etwa 10¹ bis 10⁴ reicht, mit Tick-Markierungen bei 10², 10³ und 10⁴. Jede Kategorie wird durch einen einzelnen, hellblau gefärbten Balken mit dunkler Umrandung repräsentiert, und über jedem Balken ist der exakte numerische Wert annotiert. Der höchste Balken gehört zu „Mathematical Reasoning" mit einem Wert von 7025, gefolgt von „General Reasoning" mit 1709, „Natural Scene Reasoning" mit 413, „Physical Reasoning" mit 232, „Logical Puzzle Reasoning" mit 91 und schließlich „Chemical Reasoning" als kürzester Balken mit einem Wert von 49. Die Balken sind somit strikt absteigend von links nach rechts sortiert, und keiner der Balken ist visuell besonders hervorgehoben oder anders eingefärbt als die übrigen.
